title: Copilot impact dashboard now shows feature engagement
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: GitHub now exposes 28-day active-user engagement by Copilot feature, including code completion, agent edit, passive and active code review, cloud agent, CLI, and Copilot app.
actionable_takeaway: Build a Feature Engagement Ledger that separates active users, feature counts, unavailable data, and training gaps.

title: Agentic CLI customizations now in the usage metrics API
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: GitHub Copilot reports skills, custom agents, MCP servers, slash commands, and plugins in per-user and aggregate usage reports, making customization adoption measurable.
actionable_takeaway: Track top-five usage arrays and distinct item counts, but do not add plugin totals to skill totals because plugin invocations are a subset.

title: Workflow execution protections in GitHub Actions generally available
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Actions policies can now restrict who triggers workflows and which events run them, with workflow-file targeting, insights, REST API management, and a public-repo pull_request_target default protection path.
actionable_takeaway: Create a Workflow Execution Protection Gate for deploy, release, and agent-triggered workflows before allowing broad automation writes.

title: Ubuntu 26 generally available and latest migration
author: GitHub Changelog / Allison
why_it_matters: Ubuntu 26.04 runner images are GA and ubuntu-latest migrates from Ubuntu 24.04 to 26.04 between October 19 and November 19, 2026, creating a predictable CI drift window.
actionable_takeaway: Run an Ubuntu Latest Migration Rehearsal by pinning critical workflows, testing ubuntu-26.04, and recording package/toolchain deltas.

title: GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.86 stable
author: GitHub / copilot-cli-release-app[bot]
why_it_matters: The stable release consolidates custom-instruction inheritance, plugin/skill preservation on resume, local-network sandbox status, corrupted transcript recovery, and Autopilot stop behavior.
actionable_takeaway: Upgrade only after a CLI Runtime Receipt covers instruction precedence, resume integrity, sandbox display, transcript recovery, and accepted-completion stop.

title: OpenAI Codex 0.155.0 stable
author: OpenAI / GitHub Actions
why_it_matters: Codex 0.155.0 moves from alpha activity into a documented stable release with experimental voice, live reasoning summaries, task hiding/archiving/deletion, Touch ID MCP verification, daemon update controls, and restart recovery.
actionable_takeaway: Treat stable Codex upgrades as an operator-surface change: test voice off/on, MCP verification, daemon restart recovery, thread/task lifecycle, and account-switch cache invalidation.

title: OpenAI Node 7.18.0
author: OpenAI SDKs
why_it_matters: The Node SDK adds agent session model settings, managed Responses WebSocket sessions, prompt-cache prewarming, audio-mini choices, and WebSocket result/header validation.
actionable_takeaway: Add Managed Responses Session Contract checks for session settings, WebSocket lifecycle, cache prewarm evidence, and header/default preservation.

title: OpenAI Python 3.15.0
author: OpenAI SDKs
why_it_matters: The Python SDK aligns with Node by adding agent session model settings, compaction progress events, managed Responses WebSocket sessions, prompt-cache prewarming, and audio-mini choices.
actionable_takeaway: Keep Node/Python SDK upgrade receipts symmetrical so agent-session behavior does not diverge across runtimes.

title: Claude Code v2.1.275
author: Anthropic / GitHub Releases
why_it_matters: Claude Code adds signed-in account confirmation, send-now queued-message controls, telemetry helper warnings, claude.ai skill/plugin sync, plugin marketplace install flow, token redaction, resume hardening, and npm plugin integrity verification.
actionable_takeaway: Use it as a cross-tool checklist: account confirmation, queued sends, telemetry warning, sync opt-out, secret redaction, malformed transcript recovery, and plugin package integrity.

title: Claude Code What's New Week 37
author: Anthropic Docs
why_it_matters: The weekly digest highlights claude plugin eval, which tests a plugin against cases and graders and compares results against a no-plugin baseline.
actionable_takeaway: Turn useful Codex/Claude workflow plugins into evaluated assets with test cases, graders, and a baseline before daily use.

title: REST API endpoints for Copilot usage metrics
author: GitHub Docs
why_it_matters: GitHub Docs define daily and 28-day Copilot usage reports, signed download links, enterprise/organization permissions, and a one-year historical access window.
actionable_takeaway: Persist report_day, date range, download-link expiry, permission scope, and null/absent field semantics in metrics ingestion jobs.

title: Controlling who can execute GitHub Actions workflows
author: GitHub Docs
why_it_matters: The docs explain layered enterprise/org/repo policies, workflow path targeting, actor rules, event rules, evaluate mode, and policy insights for allowed or blocked workflow runs.
actionable_takeaway: Before enforcement, run evaluate mode, inspect would-block results, then scope policies by repository class, workflow path, actor, and event.
